lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Greetings!

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: This is the head maid of Maid Cafe,

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Cocoa, at your service.
So much formality.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: A maid must be formal at all times,

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: most of all when she is introducing herself to others.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: At least that's what Ade told me.
How very professional of you.
What a polite little munchkin you are.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: But of course.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Being a maid is my profession.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: I must follow all necessary protocols.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: I'm no munchkin!

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Ever since I set out to become a professional maid,

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: such mawkish terms of endearment

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: have become a thing of the past for me.
All right then. Anyway, what made you reach out to me over Blabla?

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: To appoint you as master.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Boss Mirrorball informed me that

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: I am now in your employ,

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: which makes you my master.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: In exchange for looking after me,

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: I will do my utmost to serve you in any way possible.
All right, I will do my best.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Great.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: You know, technically I'm not supposed to do this...

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: But next time you come to our cafe,

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: I'll be sure to give you some extra ketchup.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: I can get away with it because I'm the head maid.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Just don't say anything to Ade or Soda.
Got it.
I'll have to stop by the Maid Cafe sometime soon.
